name: idea-loop
description: Closed loop from idea to shipped engineering, backed by a docs/ Obsidian vault as its knowledge base. Ten skills, no state machine — grill, uiux-imagine, uiux-refine and dreaming stay human-invoked (an interview, two design stages whose every exit stops on a person, and destructive disposals); the other six can also be started by a caller, so a spec can be executed and taken to a reviewed PR with the human stepping in only to decide and to sign off. No state machine either — a file's existence IS its status: a spec exists while the work is in flight, and is deleted once an ADR records why/how/result. grill runs a design-tree interview in frontier rounds (facts are the agent's job, decisions are the human's — including walking the problem through in a browser before any decision hangs on its root cause, which also yields the spec's evidence images) until nothing is silently assumed, and when a product decision cannot be settled in prose it calls prototype in-session; prototype is throwaway code answering ONE question — a clickable single-file state model, or structurally distinct gray-box variants — whose artifact and verdict both land in the raw bucket; to-spec lands that conversation as a raw transcript plus one spec readable by humans and agents alike (problem shown through grill's reproduced evidence before the root cause, user stories drawn as one tree per scenario, implementation decisions, a technical overview — backend and front-end-internal sequence diagrams plus front-end interaction screen-flows composed by scripts/flow-compose.mjs, rules in references/spec-figures.md — then testing decisions); uiux-imagine is the divergent design half, human-invoked, and runs only while the spec sits at 等设计冻结 — it opens just the altitude still undecided (language / structure / layout / component), and says up front whether the UI is new or evolves live UI — in which case the live components are replicated first and variants only change what this spec touches, renders every round straight into a clickable comparison page in the built-in browser at the lowest fidelity that tells the variants apart, takes only directional notes, runs no critic, and ships exactly ONE artifact: a seven-section direction note (the chosen variant carrying a six-item composition list) left under the worktree's .tmp/uiux-imagine/<spec-slug>/ for refine and never written into the spec, its shape checked by scripts/direction-note-check.mjs; the two uiux-* stages are a bracketed, conditional segment of the forward loop (grill → to-spec → [uiux-imagine → uiux-refine] → to-ticket → implement → pr-review): you walk them only when to-spec landed the spec at 等设计冻结, and a spec that landed at 在飞 goes straight from to-spec to to-ticket. uiux-refine is the convergent half, also human-invoked, run in the same session — the skill is only the calling mechanism: the session orchestrates while the plugin's idea-loop:designer agent (opus alias, effort high) builds the canvas in the project's docs/design/<spec-slug>/ from that note alone (never from imagine's renders) and converges it in a loop where a fresh idea-loop:ui-master critic each round (fable alias, Read-only, never sees canvas code) returns findings plus a score that scripts/critic-score.mjs audits against its own findings; every return is shown in the built-in browser and the human's notes are triaged and relayed to the same designer, which routes each finding by kind (direction stops for the human, pattern earns reference research, craft is fixed in place), then runs a subtraction pass and an AI-tells pass, sends the loop back to uiux-imagine only when a finding or a human note contradicts the direction note, and on the human's signature freezes the canvas, per-cell screenshots and ledger in place under docs/design/<spec-slug>/ (kept after the spec is deleted), writes a freeze summary into the spec and its interaction screen-flows into the technical overview, deletes the .tmp intermediates and flips the spec to 在飞 — or freezes part and sends the rest back to uiux-imagine; design-modeling is the only writer of the project's DESIGN.md — it creates one (measured from live UI, or from the language uiux-imagine just chose, in the same session), distills the 设计法候选 that uiux-refine leaves in freeze records through a five-layer admission table (workflow / general principle / product visual language / page decision / current state), and reconciles the file against code, waiting on the human before every write; format is wholly the official @google/design.md CLI's, read and linted at @latest; to-ticket slices a spec into tracer-bullet vertical cuts with blocking edges, each a temporary credential deleted on merge, and holds the design-freeze gate for UI work; implement runs a whole spec: the calling session orchestrates and dispatches a fresh idea-loop:implementer per ticket along the Blocked-by graph — each turns one ticket into one commit on the integration branch (TDD at the agreed seams, measurement/pixel comparators on UI tickets, human-verify flows and GIFs recorded from the implementation), defers what it cannot prove only to a named receiver, and stops with two options and a recommendation when a behaviour is undecided; the orchestrator keeps going on whatever does not depend on it, and each time nothing is left to do it opens a new bot thread on the draft PR (the project's GitHub App, never the human's identity) with the decisions and the delivery evidence, which lives in a per-PR draft release and never enters git; the human answers in the thread as themselves and resolving it is their sign-off; once everything has landed the PR turns ready and pr-review runs one round per call: an idea-loop:pr-reviewer runs the repo's declared checks keeping only changed lines, two read-only Codex processes (gpt-5.6-sol, effort high) answer Spec and Standards separately, every Spec finding is reproduced and drawn, every quote and code snippet is checked mechanically, and the round lands as a new bot thread where the human rules fix / not / backlog — fixes go back through the ticket that introduced them, the next round and the merge are the human's call; dreaming reconciles every doc against origin/main — including CLAUDE.md — and proposes disposals the human approves before anything moves. A domain glossary — the target repo's GLOSSARY.md, adapted from mattpocock/skills' domain-modeling, rules in references/glossary.md — holds terms and nothing else: grill adds or renames a term the moment the human answers a term question, dreaming corrects or removes terms only with approval, every other skill only reads it, and pr-review lists missing terms in its round post without writing them; scripts/glossary-check.mjs lints its format from a hook and from the target repo's CI. The design side lives here too, not as a separate plugin: the taste and craft references under references/design/ (core law, surface/module/component altitude protocols, the static-UI and motion protocols), a deterministic design-lint hook that fires on writes to canvas HTML under docs/design/<spec-slug>/ (and the legacy design-preview/ dirs) plus a hook that runs the official DESIGN.md lint on every write to a DESIGN.md, a headless Playwright MCP server, and the two refine agents under agents/. prototype, uiux-imagine and uiux-refine are pinned to a baseline eval under evals/ — one real case carrying a minimal DESIGN.md + PRODUCT.md, run once and archived, re-run on every change to a rubric, a prompt or a SKILL.md, with the whole loop's wiring check riding along as its assertions rather than as a one-off dry run; this is a deliberate exception to the repo-wide "subjective output skips quantitative eval" convention, stated as such next to it. Generalized out of a real project (Toeflair) — reads the current repo's own CLAUDE.md and lint/typecheck config rather than hardcoding either. Skills own the mechanics; the human owns every judgement call.
